name: Integrated Vegetable Development Program
benefit: - **For General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹1,500/- per hectare, including ₹1,400/- for hybrid/improved seeds and ₹100/- for seed treatment medicine. - **For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹2,250/- per hectare, including ₹2,100/- for hybrid/improved seeds and ₹150/- for seed treatment medicine.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the General/ Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe category.
